_comment: Copy to cod.config.json (gitignored) or point $COD_CONFIG at a copy, then run `python3 -m scripts.cod doctor`.
Every key is optional: a game left out is found in your Steam libraries, as its install or its downloaded depots.
games.<game>: one folder, a list of folders, or {"dirs": [...], "exe": "<file>", "use": "auto|depots|install"}. Games: mw2 mw3 bo1 bo2 ghosts aw cw.
dirs: folders used as given (a full 32-bit install anywhere, or depot folders). --game-dir <game>=<dir> and $COD_<GAME>_DIR win over them.
use: what Steam detection may pick when no dirs are named: auto (a 32-bit install, else the depots), depots, or install. --use <game>=... wins.
MW2, MW3, Black Ops and Black Ops II must be 32-bit builds: docs/cod/README.md#32-bit-builds.
exe: an executable to read (never run) for wavelet images; a 64-bit install's serves, and is found on its own.
iw6_durango: the folder holding iw6mp64_dh_server_durango.exe and .map (Ghosts only; $IW6_DURANGO).
iw6_durango_types: the type table generated from that build's .pdb (Ghosts only; $IW6_DURANGO_TYPES).
s1_layout_x360: the struct layout generated from the AW X360 build (optional; $S1_LAYOUT_X360).
ooz: the built ooz library, libooz.so or ooz.dll (Black Ops Cold War only; $OOZ_LIB).
